headlines.text: That Wednesday in 2020, a new chapter began as Kenny Omega vs. Sammy Guevara fought for the brand-new AAA Mega Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.54 ? a solid showing. The first-ever AAA Mega Championship match to air on Dynamite, taped during the strange early days of the pandemic ? Guevara wrestled to a custom fan section of cardboard cutouts he'd made himself, adding surreal comedy to an otherwise hard-fought title defense.
Flash back to 2026, when Darby Allin vs. Rush fought it out in a No Count Out Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.63 ? a solid showing.

Turning the clock back to 2022: Ricky Starks vs. Swerve Strickland clashed for the FTW Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.15 ? a strong outing. It was the first title opportunity of Swerve Strickland's career. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2026, when Kenny Omega vs. Swerve Strickland fought it out with the Authority Position and a Number One Contender spot on the line, setting the tone as the night's opener on Dynamite, rated 8.18 ? an excellent showing.
Turning the clock back to 2026: The Dogs (Connors & Finlay) arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.80.
Turning the clock back to 2026: Thekla vs. Mina Shirakawa fought tooth and nail for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.45.
